ai_summary: AceVector Limited reported robust H1 FY27 consolidated revenue growth of 17% year-on-year, primarily driven by a 31% increase in Snapdeal's fashion Net Merchandise Value (NMV) and 15% revenue growth from its Unicommerce SaaS platform, both leveraging AI-first strategies. While the company experienced an increased adjusted EBITDA loss for H1 FY27 compared to the prior year due to strategic growth investments, a significant red flag, it demonstrated a sequential reduction in losses by over 50% from Q1 to Q2. Management expects improved profitability and operating leverage in H2 FY27 as investment intensity moderates.
